**Batch, in order** (`docs/briefs/bugs/batch.txt`):

2. `b6-1010-let-mut-literal-owned-field.md`: a `let mut` text literal pushed into a variant that owns its text reaches rustc as a type mismatch.

One is a function with named lifetimes, the other a typed `let w: ref Vec[T]`. I ran every test row of b7 on today's binary; both fail the way the brief says. b5 and b6 were written last round and never ran. I re-ran their probes and they still fail as written.

Start order: run `b5` next with `builder`, `opus`, 80 turns, $15. It is cheap and certain.

- I filed #1048 (`ready`): a function type with two view parameters and a view result lowers with no lifetime, so rustc refuses it. It happens with text as well as lists.
- This lane holds `wip` on #1002, #1010 and #1016; each still has one status label.

The report is at `docs/briefs/bugs/architect-task.md.report.md`, but I did not commit it, as the task says the driver commits reports.
